notes.title: V0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
The game has been patched to fix a few bugs.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where passives would not work if an enemy died from a debuff.
[*] Fixed a bug where Bluebug's melee attacks would not reach from certain directions
[*] Fixed a game balance issue where enemies have too much initial health
[/list]
